answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable onyx bond before it can vouch or attest, with the bond slashed if peers catch it backing a fake identity. Like a falcon circling a field, the network watches for clusters of accounts funded from one source and freezes their rewards until a human-verified challenge clears them. A yarrow-style slow start also helps: new identities earn only a trickle of attestations until they build a public history, so spinning up a thousand sockpuppets costs real money and time for almost no payoff.
